title: Flat base change preserves Koszul regularity
statement: Let A and S be commutative rings and S a flat A-algebra [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. For a finite sequence f:Fin r -> A, if f is Koszul-regular [def-weil-pbc-koszul-regular-sequence], then its image under A -> S is Koszul-regular. The Koszul complex is [def-weil-pbc-koszul-complex].

proof.text: Apply the explicit complex isomorphism between extension of scalars of K_A(f) and K_S(algebraMap A S composed with f).

For each nonzero degree, convert the assumed zero homology to exactness. Flatness makes ModuleCat.extendScalars preserve finite limits; it already preserves finite colimits. HomologicalComplex.ExactAt.map therefore preserves exactness. Transport exactness through the complex isomorphism and convert back to zero homology.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 15.31.5; explicit complex isomorphism followed by Mathlib exact functor preservation
